description: He wears a long ivory patterned tunic with broad plum and gold woven front bands, cuffs and hem, beneath a plum outer robe and shoulder mantle. The mantle drapes across the upper chest and down one side, held by a large round gold clasp with a purple stone. A broad dark brown and gold belt with an ornamented circular buckle and hanging patterned strap secures the waist. Wide layered sleeves show the ivory tunic beneath. The garment reaches nearly to the ankles, above dark brown leather shoes or short boots. A ring decorates one hand. No armor, weapon or headgear is present.
